question:
**Direction : **In the following, part of the sentences (marked as A, B, C, D) has an error. Locate the correct alternative.

Each of the boys (A) / play cricket (B) / in the playground. (C) / No error (D)
solution:
The correct answer is 'B' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'play' is incorrect.
 
• The subject in the given sentence is 'Each of the boys', which is a singular subject.
 
• When the subject is singular, the verb should also be in its singular form.
 
• Therefore, the correct singular verb form should be 'plays' instead of 'play'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *Each of the boys **plays** cricket in the playground.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (A):** There is no error in this part as 'Each of the boys' is correctly used as a singular subject.
 
• **Option 3 (C):** There is no error in this part as 'in the playground' correctly describes the location where the action takes place.
